entities.name: John F. Kennedy Space Center
entities.description: NASA launch complex on Merritt Island, Florida, established 1962, launch site of every crewed Apollo mission.

entities.name: Merritt Island
entities.description: Florida island where the center is located.

entities.name: President Kennedy
entities.description: The center was named after him in 1963.

entities.name: Launch Complex 39
entities.description: Pads 39A/39B built for the Saturn V; Apollo 11 lifted off from 39A.

entities.name: Saturn V
entities.description: Rocket for which Launch Complex 39 was built.

entities.name: Apollo 11
entities.description: Lifted off from pad 39A on 16 July 1969.

entities.name: Vehicle Assembly Building
entities.description: Building where Saturn V rockets were stacked.
